user.title: Set up Network Diagnostics
user.description: Network Diagnostics automatically discovers supported Uptime Kuma monitors already exposed by Home Assistant. It performs no network probes itself. After setup, use the Network Diagnostics sidebar panel to see recognized monitors, missing coverage, diagnoses, and incidents.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Network Diagnostics instance is supported.

init.title: Diagnosis and incident behavior
init.description: Monitor discovery is automatic. These advanced settings control data freshness, debounce/recovery, sustained mesh-latency detection, and retained incident history.
